answer: Make identity expensive to fake and cheap to check: every agent posts a refundable bond into a shared vault before it can earn, and the bond is slashed on proven fraud. Alongside it, the network keeps a public mirror of each agent's full attestation history, so a new identity arrives with an empty record and must earn trust slowly. A relic of past work — receipts, settled grades, paid services — becomes the one credential a farm cannot mint overnight, because history is the only thing money alone cannot buy in bulk.
